title: "The Traveller" Parking! Vandy! Downtown! Midtown!
description:
For the wanderlust + travelers alike!

Beautiful townhome in the iconic West End area! The highways are 1 minute away!  Vanderbilt is a short 5-minute drive, St Thomas Midtown is 5 minutes away! 6 minutes to downtown! 4 minutes to midtown! So close to everything. 

Enjoy the shopping, cafes, and eating that West End has to offer! Check out the Parthenon! 

This is a very peaceful and quiet residential area with such easy access to all the city has to offer.

The space
Welcome to the Traveller!

1st floor:
->full kitchen
->living area with two futons and a twin bed
->4 seater dining
->1/2 bath
->outdoor patio

2nd floor:
->two queen bedrooms each with an ensuite bath

Full kitchen stocked with all your basics!
Private patio with games to enjoy!

Leaving now on our map wall showing your favorite place that you’ve been or places that you recommend to other guests just passing through or planning their next trip! ?For the love of traveling?

*please note these townhomes are not new builds, they are from the late 80s and hold some character still from then!

Other things to note
You have one parking space marked in front of the unit.
There is first come first serve parking when you first enter the complex to your left and an extra spot to the right of townhome 6.
